note.zh: 在本地通过 Claude Code 以 claude-sonnet-5-5（max）一次生成，未经修改，耗时 197 分钟。跑在 Agent Bench 隔离 runner：空 workspace、无 skill/plugin/MCP。该次运行中模型通过 Bash 执行过带网络请求的脚本，runner 的 No-Web 严格检查因此将其标记为违规；维护者决定保留原样，仅供观察效果，请勿视为严格 No-Web 成绩。本页为其构建产物（部署时由源码打包为单文件）。
note.en: One-shot by claude-sonnet-5-5 (max) in Claude Code, unmodified, 197 minutes. Run on the Agent Bench isolated runner: empty workspace, no skills/plugins/MCP. During this run the model executed a Bash script that made network requests, which the runner's strict No-Web check flagged as a violation; the maintainer chose to keep it as-is for observation only, so do not treat it as a strict No-Web result. This page is its build output (bundled from source into a single file at deploy time).
